THIS CCC IS FILED UNDER SECTION 11 AND 12 OF THE  CONTEMPT OF COURTS ACT, 1971, R/W. ARTICLE 215 OF  CONSTITUTION OF INDIA,1950, PLEASED TO EXERCISE ITS  JURISDICTION UNDER SECTION 12 OF THE CONTEMPT OF COURTS  ACT AND TO INITIATE CONTEMPT OF COURT PROCEEDINGS  AGAINST THE ACCUSED FOR NOT IMPLEMENTING THE ORDER  -2-  NC: 2023:KHC-D:12193-DB  CCC No. 100252 of 2023 DATED 08.08.2022 PASSED BY THIS HON BLE COURT IN MFA NO.104270/2019 VIDE ANNEXURE-A AND PUNISH THE ACCUSED IN ACCORDANCE WITH LAW, AND FURTHER BE PLEASED TO AWARD COSTS OF THE PROCEEDINGS, IN THE IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE AND EQUITY.
 THIS CONTEMPT PETITION COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, KRISHNA KUMAR J., PASSED THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

Learned counsel for respondent/accused has filed compliance affidavit which reads as under:
I, Naveen H. V., aged about 54 years, working as SLAO, KIADB, Dharw Division, do hereby solemnly affirm and state on oath as follows:
1. I am the accused/respondent no.1 in the above- mentioned conter petition and I am fully conversant with the facts of the case.
I am working as SLAO in KIADB, Dharwad Division, Dharwad.
statements made by me in this affidavit are true to the best of knowledge and belief.
2. At the outset, I respectfully submit that I have the highest regard this Hon'ble Court and am duty bound to comply with the direct issued by this Hon'ble court.
I submit that I have always obeyed will always obey the orders passed by this Hon'ble court.
Without prejudice to what is stated above, I respectfully submit that the order passed by this Hon'ble Court has been complied by the accused/respondent.

3. I state that the above contempt petition is filed by the complainant alleging wilful and deliberate disobedience of the judgment of the Hon'ble High Court dated 08-08-2022 passed in MFA No.No.
104270/2019 (LAC).

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: I state that in MFA No.104270/2019 (LAC) this Hon'ble Court has enhanced the market value at Rs.18,900/- per gunta along with statutory benefits to the extent 2 acre 15 gunta in Sy.No.42/2 situated at M.T. Sagar, Hubballi, Dist. Dharwad.

5. I state that as per judgment passed by this Hon'ble Court the accused/Respondent no.1 has calculated the total compensation payable at Rs.1,18,95,596/- and same was approved by our Head Office and released the amount and also directed to deposit the same amount before this Hon'ble Court.

Therefore accused/Respondent no.1 has deposited amount through Union Bank of India Cheque No.004877, dated 10-10-2023 for Rs.1,18,95,596/- (One crore eighteen lakhs ninety- five thousand five hundred ninety-six rupees only) today i.e. 11-10-2023 in the registry.
6. Hence, in view of the above facts, I state that there has been delay in compliance of the order due to Administrative exigencies.
The order of the Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka, Dharwad Bench was duly complied.

entities.text: High Court of Karnataka, Dharwad Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: I once again reiterate that I have the highest respect for the directions issued by this Hon'ble Court, and it has always been the endeavour to comply with the order passed by this Hon'ble Court.
Hence, I request the Hon'ble Court to drop the above-mentioned contempt proceedings as against the answering accused/respondent, in the interest of justice and equity.
2. Learned counsel for the complainants seeks permission to withdraw the aforesaid deposited amount by the respondent/accused.
3. The compliance affidavit and submission is placed on record.
The complainants are permitted to withdraw the NC: 2023:KHC-D:12193-DB amount deposited by the respondent/accused.
Registry is directed disburse the said amount in favour of the complainants immediately without delay.
4. In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and submission, the present contempt proceedings are dropped.

Sd JUDGE Sd JUDGE JTR Abhinandan S/O Jinadatta Rao Gongadi vs The Special Land Acquisition Officer on 11 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29892967/
